status: confirmatory causal audit after separate diagnostic seeds 72000-72007
architecture: native C4 rotational-relation reactor; no new mechanism added
conceptual_prior: prospective plate record: El fluir de la geometría relacional común

exposure.same_exogenous_noise: identical across all relation histories within seed

common_present.future_noise: identical across all transplanted histories within seed

future_response: concatenation of 8 future action vectors and 8 native recurrent-state increments dx

controls.label_shuffle: permute which donor relation label is assigned to each intact response; response data unchanged
controls.component_scramble: independently permute donor identity for m, theta, r, K, b, gh; preserves marginal distributions of every history component while destroying coherent historical package

metrics.history_imprint_norm: mean Euclidean norm between each donor-history future response and the phi=0 carrier-history response
metrics.response_RSA: correlation of pairwise standardized future-response distances with true circular chord distances between donor relations

primary_hypotheses.H2_relational_specificity: true response RSA > mean label-shuffle RSA
primary_hypotheses.H3_coherent_history_package: true response RSA > mean component-scramble RSA
primary_hypotheses.H4_nontrivial_metric_structure: mean true response RSA >0.07 AND >60% seeds exceed 0.05

tests: H2-H3 one-sided sign-flip across 64 seeds with Holm correction; each also requires >60% favorable seeds and bootstrap 95% lower bound >0. H1/H4 are preregistered threshold criteria.
secondary_only: PCA2 explained variance of future responses

interpretation_rule.all_pass: with present surface/recurrent state fixed, coherent native history causally organizes the system's subsequent trajectory according to relational similarity
interpretation_rule.H1_only: history matters causally but no common relational organization is established
interpretation_rule.H2_H3_without_H4: relation organization exists relative to controls but is too weak to call a stable common metric geometry
